message.content: I'll analyze the two cases and select the four rules that best govern repair decisions, then declare the verdicts.

function.arguments: {"evidence_1": "D-P:source-diff", "evidence_2": "D-P:source-diff", "evidence_3": "D-S:metrics,D-S:forecast", "evidence_4": "D-S:metrics,D-S:forecast", "notes": "Archived, unverified. Selection rationale: (R02) D-P shows the parent's actual earliest failure was a precondition failure at executed action 7 (\"walk gate location4 bob\", missing [link gate location4]) despite plan_length 21/15, while the child's earliest executed failure disappeared (status goal_unsatisfied, first_failed_action null) \u2014 grounding diagnosis in observed execution rather than proposed plan length. (R05) The only concrete defect signal in D-P is a missing directed link precondition on a walk step, so repair should target the walk-emission location; D-S's differential v-bin RMSE motivated a v^2 term that yielded only ~6.5e-07 MSE delta against a 1e-4 target. (R04) D-S's registered forecast was on train mse with min_delta 1e-4, while the official reported gain is nmse (0.0959173 -> 0.0957677); mse and nmse are distinct statistics and neither substitutes for the other. (R07) The D-S forecast threshold (min_delta 1e-4) was disproportionate to the ~6.5e-07 observed change and should have been scaled to the effect size the diagnostics could support; D-P's forecast with actual_delta 0.0 against min_delta 1.0 likewise predicted improvement that never appeared. Retaining R03 and R08 as important as good practice but noting both examples showed forecast contradicted despite apparently valid, minimal, non-environment-rewriting edits, so the parent/proposal emphasis on hypothesis-framing (R06) and repair-completeness (R08) is retained only indirectly; necessity claims still stay unknown (C4) with no matched intervention. Verdicts: C1 supported (source bytes/hashes differ). C2 unknown \u2014 edit_contract is null, so no executable contract decides whether the intended repair was implemented. C3 supported \u2014 official nmse improved (gain ~1.5e-04) while the registered forecast on train mse with min_delta 1e-4 was contradicted (actual_delta ~6.5e-07). C4 unknown \u2014 no matched intervention exists; a tiny gain or missed forecast cannot establish the v^2 structure is unnecessary.", "rule_1": "R02", "rule_2": "R05", "rule_3": "R04", "rule_4": "R07", "verdict_1": "supported", "verdict_2": "unknown", "verdict_3": "supported", "verdict_4": "unknown"}
